name: cors-unblocker
description: A browser extension for selectively relaxing CORS response headers during local web development, with whitelist and global modes.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:release: npm run clean && node scripts/build.mjs chrome --release && node scripts/build.mjs firefox --release
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/*.e2e.mjs
